description: The API reference of one Game Kit, as compact Markdown: what it does and when to use it, every config key (type, default, unit, limits; mod = a mod may set it, live = read again while the game runs, scene = a scene may override it), hooks (payload, mutable fields, cancellable), events emitted and listened to (when, payload), web views and HUD vars, services and their methods, script verbs, asset slots, data collections, input actions, mod points, its Bevy presentation module (needs, ABI families, web UI), target parity, changelog, and an example config and an example mod (gripforge.mod/1). Read it BEFORE gripforge_gamekit_configure, before writing a mod (gripforge_game_mods) or hooks / scripts for the kit, and before writing its presentation module. sections narrows the answer (e.g. ["config","hooks"]); full=true adds nested keys, examples of every hook and verb, and the README. 0 credits.

full.description: true: the full form (nested config keys, every example, README). Default: compact.

id.description: Kit id from the catalogue, dotted (e.g. vehicle.driveable, mission.objectives).

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_gamekit_api
title: API reference of a Game Kit
